description: This file declares external API function prototypes for the ANSC OcoVer2 object in the BroadWay Service Delivery System, including creation, removal, initialization, engagement, and cancellation functions.

methods.name: AnscCreateOcoVer2
methods.description: Creates an instance of the OcoVer2 object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: AnscOcoVer2Create
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new OcoVer2 object.

methods.name: AnscOcoVer2Remove
methods.description: Removes and frees resources associated with the OcoVer2 object.

methods.name: AnscOcoVer2EnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the OcoVer2 object.

methods.name: AnscOcoVer2Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the OcoVer2 object, setting up internal state.

methods.name: AnscOcoVer2Engage
methods.description: Activates or engages the OcoVer2 object to start its operation.

methods.name: AnscOcoVer2Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the operation of the OcoVer2 object.

methods.name: AnscOcoVer2SubEngage
methods.description: Engages subordinate or sub-components of the OcoVer2 object.

methods.name: AnscOcoVer2SubCancel
methods.description: Cancels subordinate or sub-components of the OcoVer2 object.
